questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At det skulle være et spansktalende land

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Så længe man selv gør en aktiv indsats og opsøger den information man har brug for, så er det relativt nemt

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der skulle have været afholdt en introuge, men dette var aflyst pga corona og politiske problemer med campus. Derfor ingen.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Universitet var længe om at melde noget information ud, hvilket var stressende når KU også har nogle deadlines man skal overholde.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: God ide at finde nogle kontakter - andre studerende - der kan hjælpe

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Man har frihed til at gøre hvad man vil, uden at der er regler som på campus dorms.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er virkelig mange muligheder, helt klart noget for alle

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Da kursuskataloget blev offentliggjort, havde vi samtidig fået en tilmeldingsblanket hvor man bare skulle udfylde hvilke kurser man ville have. Meget nemt. Dog kom kursuskataloget MEGET sent ud, under en uge før deadline for tilmelding, og det var umuligt at navigere i og finde kurserne. Jeg er meget glad for de kurser jeg har haft, men jeg tror også at jeg har overset nogle spændende kurser pga. det forvirrende og fuldstændig uoverskuelige  katalog

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne skrive til universitetet, ellers intet.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle mine fem ønskede kurser

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Lad være med selv at lede efter kurserne. De kurser du kan finde på UDLAPs hjemmeside er forældede og bliver ikke udbudt. Du bliver nødt til at vente på at UDLAP sender dig en mail med det aktuelle kursuskatalog.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg har lært SINDSSYGT meget af at studere på UDLAP

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det kræver en del deltagelse og engagement fra din egen side af for at følge med, men det er ikke svært at følge med og score gode karakterer. Underviserne er meget gavmilde med karakterer

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der var virkelig mange lektier, opgaver, deleksaminer og præsentationer undervejs. På KU handler det mest bare om at læse sine tekster og møde op til undervisningen og skrive noter, på UDLAP er man meget mere aktiv og en del af undervisningen

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Arte y cultura de las Américas
Estudio de la Traducción
Sociolingüística 
Textos de la Conquista 
Comunicación y globalización

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Arte y cultura de las Américas: hvis man vil lære om kulturhistorie i Amerika 
Sociolingüística: Et kursus, hvor man både lærer meget om lingvistik i Mexico, men også et kursus hvor man virkelig får reflekteret over en masse ting ift. sprog. 
Comunicación y globalización: Mega relevant, interessant og udfordrende kursus. Meget aktuelt for vores tidsalder

Housing DKK per month *

Food DKK per month *

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Det er ikke mange penge, men man skal hele tiden købe vand og altid give drikkepenge på cafeer/restauranter! Drikkepenge er 10-20% af prisen

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Mad og transport er absurd billigt.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der har ikke været mange tilbud åbne på campus pga. covid

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Forskellige organisationer organiserer fester, udflugter, salsa timer, spanskundervisning osv. Deltag i så meget du har lyst til og orker. FOMO slår til nogle gange, men det er vigtigt at mærke efter og lytte til din krop.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Rejs rundt så meget som muligt!!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det er en meget anderledes kultur end vi kender fra Danmark og Europa, så det kan måske godt være lidt svært at tilpasse sig i starten.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Vær åben, det er de lokale! De er altid klar på en fest, kaffe, vise dig rundt, tage dig med hjem til deres familie osv.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Pas

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Mad :)

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Husk at komme ud af studierne og ud af huset og oplev landet
2. Hav tålmodighed med de forskellige processer du går igennem. Det tager tid, men alt løser sig altid 
3. Tænk ikke så meget over penge! Dette er the time of your life. Få så mange oplevelser ud af det som muligt. Penge kan du altid tjene senere. Oplevelser får du ikke igen

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Sørg for at blive venner med de lokale og få lært / øvet noget spansk!! Mexicanere er super søde og tålmodige

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Klar forbedring af mit spanske og en bred kulturforståelse for Mexico og latinamerikansk kultur

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At få fuldført alle afleveringer, præsentation osv, samtidig med at have tid til oplevelser!

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
